description: Header file defining the Engine class for Android's audio policy engine, including method declarations, class structure, and external dependencies.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Represents the audio policy engine, inheriting from EngineBase and implementing AudioPolicyPluginInterface, managing audio device strategies, configurations, and interfaces.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Constructor for the Engine class.

methods.name: ~Engine
methods.description: Default destructor for the Engine class.

methods.name: queryInterface
methods.description: Template method to query specific interfaces.

methods.name: loadFromXmlConfigWithFallback
methods.description: Loads engine configuration from an XML file with fallback options.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the engine is properly initialized.

methods.name: setPhoneState
methods.description: Sets the current phone (call) state.

methods.name: getPhoneState
methods.description: Retrieves the current phone state.

methods.name: setForceUse
methods.description: Sets forced usage configurations for audio policies.

methods.name: getForceUse
methods.description: Gets current forced usage configurations.

methods.name: setDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Sets the connection state of a device.

methods.name: getOutputDevicesForAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves output devices matching specific audio attributes.

methods.name: getOutputDevicesForStream
methods.description: Retrieves output devices for a specific audio stream.

methods.name: getInputDeviceForAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves input device matching specific audio attributes.

methods.name: setDevicesRoleForStrategy
methods.description: Assigns device roles for a given product strategy.

methods.name: removeDevicesRoleForStrategy
methods.description: Removes device roles for a product strategy.

methods.name: clearDevicesRoleForStrategy
methods.description: Clears device roles for a product strategy.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a new audio stream type.

methods.name: addInputSource
methods.description: Adds a new input source.

methods.name: setVolumeProfileForStream
methods.description: Sets volume profile for a specific stream.

methods.name: setDeviceForInputSource
methods.description: Associates a device with an input source.

methods.name: setDeviceAddressForProductStrategy
methods.description: Sets device address for a product strategy.

methods.name: setDeviceTypesForProductStrategy
methods.description: Sets device types for a product strategy.

methods.name: getProductStrategyByName
methods.description: Retrieves product strategy by name, delegating to EngineBase.

methods.name: disableDevicesForStrategy
methods.description: Disables specified devices for a strategy.

methods.name: enableDevicesForStrategy
methods.description: Enables specified devices for a strategy.

methods.name: setOutputDevicesConnectionState
methods.description: Sets connection state for output devices.

methods.name: loadAudioPolicyEngineConfig
methods.description: Loads engine configuration from an XML file.

methods.name: getDevicesForProductStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves devices associated with a product strategy.
